guard: the interactive retirement plane states `not-executed` on every refusal it raises before the retirement barrier, and states no outcome for a failure inside the barrier
why: `cotal actor grant` and `cotal actor revoke` refuse a failed retirement only when the auth service states that it did not run (SPEC 13.3). The service answered every exception on its retirement door with 400, so a token check or a deleted head that failed before the barrier read the same as a barrier that failed partway.

Section E of the suite drives the real plane over a real broker. A bad token, a head at another uid and a deleted head must each refuse with `not-executed`, and a barrier whose eviction never verifies must refuse with no outcome after its head reached `retiring`. P1 to P3 drop the statement from each pre-barrier refusal; P4 claims it for the barrier too.
The suite imports the auth package from source, so a mutation needs no rebuild.

mutations.name: P1 a token check before the barrier refuses without stating that nothing was retired
mutations.expectRed: an owner that is not a derived token refuses bad-request, not-executed
mutations.cell: an owner that is not a derived token refuses bad-request, not-executed

mutations.name: P2 a head at another uid refuses without stating that nothing was retired
mutations.find: but the authority head is ${head.mapping.state} at ${head.mapping.lifecycleUid}`, undefined, "not-executed");
mutations.replace: but the authority head is ${head.mapping.state} at ${head.mapping.lifecycleUid}`);
mutations.expectRed: a head active at ANOTHER uid refuses conflict, not-executed, and stays untouched
mutations.cell: a head active at ANOTHER uid refuses conflict, not-executed, and stays untouched

mutations.name: P3 a head read that fails before the barrier refuses without stating that nothing was retired
mutations.expectRed: a deleted head refuses failed-precondition, not-executed
mutations.cell: a deleted head refuses failed-precondition, not-executed

mutations.name: P4 a failure inside the barrier is stated as not executed
mutations.expectRed: CONTROL: a barrier that fails after it began states no outcome, so the caller reads unknown
mutations.cell: CONTROL: a barrier that fails after it began states no outcome, so the caller reads unknown
